style: Painterly cinematic concept art of a place in an invented world; it must not resemble any real city, landmark or country. Wide establishing shot, eye at a high vantage point, natural atmospheric perspective, rich but believable colour, visible gouache-and-oil brush texture, fine architectural detail. Any people are tiny distant figures with no visible faces. Flags and banners use plain invented designs, never real national flags or political emblems unless the description names one. No readable text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, watermark, border or frame.

places.布图里亚: A temperate seafaring kingdom on a strait, morning light. A deep bay crowded with fishing boats and passing merchant sailing ships, stone quays and warehouses, a shipyard slipway on the south shore where a new wooden hull stands with only its ribs raised. Whitewashed houses with red tile roofs climb the hillside; high above, a modest manor flies a plain royal banner. Offshore islets on the horizon.
places.铁枢人民共和国: An early industrial socialist country on a broad temperate river plain, overcast grey sky. Blast furnaces and a rolling mill breathe steam and orange glow, a long steel truss railway bridge crosses the wide river to a busy marshalling yard full of freight wagons. Rows of identical brick dormitory blocks face the factory gate. Collective fields stretch flat to the horizon. Sober, monumental, smoke-softened.
places.坎普共和国: A southern river republic, late afternoon. A wide brown river winds through a valley: terraced coffee plantations climb the western slope, open cattle pasture lies on the east bank, and a river port with wooden wharves loads sacks onto barges and a small steamer. A white planter's house sits on a rise. Towering dark thunderclouds roll in from the distance with sunlight still on the fields.
places.卡法里扬帝国: A vast northern empire's frozen coast in polar night under a starry sky with faint aurora. Oil derricks with burning flare torches stand on the tundra, a grim stone fortress on a headland sweeps searchlights across a frozen bay locked in sea ice, rows of snow-buried barracks with lit windows, a narrow-gauge railway half covered by drifts. Cold blue and fire orange.
places.科鲁鲁王国: A landlocked old kingdom of river networks at golden hour. An ancient capital fills the inner bank of a river bend: a great domed cathedral and a royal palace rise above a sea of old terracotta roofs, stone bridges and river barges. Across the water, sunny slopes are covered in vineyard rows. Warm, rich, cultured.
places.伊鲁尼利亚共和国: A wealthy maritime federal republic between two oceans, bright noon. A naval harbour with three grey cruisers at anchor, a dry dock surrounded by tall cranes, and a domed white parliament hall at the head of a long tree-lined boulevard leading down to a busy commercial port with cargo ships. Clean, prosperous, confident.
places.示安神权政治: A long misty northern coast in the rainy season, soft steady rain. Wet mossy stone steps climb through a dark sacred forest of ancient cedars to a small shrine with curved roofs deep in the woods. Below it, a quiet fishing village with dark timber houses and moored boats, and a hillside graveyard with weathered stones. Muted greens and greys, gentle and solemn.
places.帕尔哈南神权政治: A theocratic northern realm at dawn. A great Gothic-inspired cathedral with twin spires and a cloistered scriptorium monastery stand on a high terrace above a river valley still filled with thick morning fog; a small village below is half drowned in mist. On a distant hillside, a ring of ancient standing stones catches the first light. Pale gold and cool blue.
places.翁吉亚共和国: A highland republic in a river valley at dusk on the eve of the spring equinox. A stone town of terraced houses around a large festival square lit by many fire braziers, crowds sitting on the steps of a columned assembly hall. Behind the town a sheer northern cliff holds the dark mouth of a sacred cave, small torchlit processions going in and out. Far behind, a colossal snow-capped mountain glows in the last light.
places.璇玑联邦: A near-future federation of lake cities, early morning as mist lifts off the water. Elegant glass research towers and white domed laboratories line the shore among trees, a slender elevated light-rail line crosses the lake on pillars, wind turbines and solar fields on the far hills. Calm, clean, softly luminous, not dystopian.
places.霁川公国: An inland river-and-lake plain of rice paddies, morning after a night of rain. Flooded paddies mirror the bright sky, terraced rice fields shine on the hillsides, grain boats queue at a stone river landing with a busy grain market under tiled roofs, and a walled manor estate stands across the river. Fresh, wet, luminous green.
places.契莱西亚保护国: A rainforest mountain protectorate in heavy rain and low cloud. Sharp jungle-covered karst peaks; at a river mouth a colonial customs house and a stone fort with cannon fly a foreign flag of plain invented design; a narrow-gauge railway threads into the mountains toward a mine. Upriver, a modest royal palace of stilted timber halls, much lower than the fort. Mist, deep greens, quiet tension.
places.罗歇阿普公国: A humid frontier river delta under a gathering storm. Sugar cane fields run right down to the muddy river, a white plantation house stands on high ground, crowded labourers' sheds huddle along the field dykes, a brick sugar mill chimney's smoke is flattened by the wind. A paddle steamer and small boats at a rough wooden river port. Dark bruised sky, a distant lightning flash, warm humid light.
places.奥嫩堡王国: A feudal northern kingdom in autumn afternoon. A stone castle crowns a rocky knoll above a village of timber-framed houses; across a small stream stands an old abbey with a cloister. Woodland around is mostly turned gold and russet, narrow strip fields freshly harvested with haystacks. Crisp, warm and quiet.
places.卡斯奎尼亚王国: A northern grassland kingdom on a windy autumn afternoon. Endless rolling steppe with long grass bending in waves from the west, a cluster of white and coloured felt yurts of horse tribes and, across a busy seasonal fair ground with horses and livestock, a knight's square stone keep with farmland. Many different invented banners stand together on the same field. Huge sky with white cumulus clouds.
places.塞雷格帝国: A severe imperial capital of 'restoration' at harsh midday. A dead-straight monumental avenue runs from a great triumphal arch to a colossal columned privy council palace, lined with identical stone buildings of equal height all hung with identical long banners of an invented deep red and gold design. Disciplined formations parade on the avenue. Outside the city edge, only dusty dirt roads and a mule cart. Oppressive symmetry, hard shadows. No real-world political symbols.
places.艾迪州: A mountainous coastal mining province in morning mist. A huge open-pit mine cut in terraced benches into the mountainside, a long conveyor belt carrying ore down to a seaside ore wharf with a waiting freighter, collective farm fields and tidy barns in the valley. Thick sea fog clings to the coastline and drifts up the valleys.
places.安那其学院: A free academy on a small hilly island in a sea strait, sunny afternoon. The campus is built up the hillside in stone terraces with retaining walls and stairways: at the summit a large old castle with round towers and a tall keep, now a lecture hall and library, with a big black banner bearing a white circled-A anarchist emblem on its front; halfway up, a long curved two-storey arcaded building; lower, a paved plaza with a large circled-A set in dark stone, workshops, greenhouses and vegetable gardens; a lighthouse on a cape and a ferry pier with sailing boats. Black flags on towers. Lively, hopeful, sunlit.
places.万知城: A neutral city-state of scholarship, morning. Inside a round crenellated city wall with four gates, four straight streets meet at a central plaza with a ring colonnade and a large bronze armillary sphere. A grand library with a ribbed verdigris copper dome and a six-column portico, tall square archive towers, a semicircular open-air stone rostrum where small figures debate, book-market stalls. Outside the walls: a river with a stone bridge, orchards and patchwork fields.
places.常灵群岛: A mysterious archipelago in a sea strait at blue dusk. A main island covered in impossibly dense dark forest, many small rocky islets, drifting mist. Out at sea to the east, a long thin vertical rift of shimmering pale light splits the air above the water. A small fishing village with warm lights on the south shore and the mast of an observation station on a northwest headland. Eerie, quiet, magical.
places.天神峰: A colossal solitary snow peak rising from a high plateau at dawn, called the Pillar to Heaven. A sea of clouds wraps its lower slopes; a pilgrims' path climbs out of the clouds on the south face, passing a few stone huts halfway up, then zigzags up toward glaciers and wind-blown snow. Rose and gold first light on the summit, deep blue shadows. Majestic and lonely.
places.法洛塔: A steep coastal port town at night. Houses stacked one above another up a hillside, warm windows; on the waterfront the day's fish market has closed and warehouse doorways glow with lanterns where an informal night market trades from crates and boats. Behind the town, fire baskets burn at the mouth of a mountain mine all night. Moored fishing boats, reflections on black water, a hint of secrecy.
places.汐见町: A small coastal harbour town at dusk in light drizzle, low tide. The tide has retreated to the end of a long ferry pier, revealing wide shining mudflats where a few tiny figures bend to dig for clams. A narrow shopping street of dark timber two-storey shops lights its lanterns one by one; a small shrine on a wooded rise. Soft rain, wet reflections, cosy melancholy.
places.南岸乡社: A seaside farming and fishing village on a bright morning on festival day. A tall maypole-like flower pillar wrapped in garlands stands in the village square, villagers building a wooden stage and hanging coloured bunting, market stalls lining the road down to a sandy beach with fishing boats. Whitewashed cottages, flower fields, sparkling sea. Joyful and gentle.
places.黑岩路矿区: A coal-mining valley on an overcast day. Pithead headframes, a brick machine shop and a small railway station crowd a narrow valley floor; a coal train of hopper wagons pulled by a steam locomotive heads out down the valley. Rows of workers' cottages on the slopes, their roofs dusted with black soot, slag heaps, thin smoke. Grim but full of human life.
places.河港救济所: A humid river port at dusk. A one-storey old timber warehouse turned into a refuge: half its roof has collapsed, revealing three rows of simple cots inside, lanterns lit; a plank notice board by the door covered in pinned paper sheets with no readable writing. Dock porters carry a few sacks of rice in from the wharf; boats and river mist behind. Warm light, humble, compassionate.
places.河湾乡社: A rice-farming village on a river bend at golden hour in autumn. Half the paddy has been cut, villagers thresh grain on a shared drying ground, a wooden waterwheel still turns in the stream, a small village schoolhouse lets out and tiny children run toward the fields. Thatched and tiled roofs, golden stubble, long shadows.
places.南境工矿区: A mining settlement on an empire's southern fringe at dusk, snow falling again. Pithead headframes switch on their lights first, then long rows of converted barrack windows glow; searchlights sweep from wooden watchtowers across a barbed-wire fence; a narrow-gauge ore railway and an ore-dressing plant. Blue twilight, cold snow, small warm lights. Heavy, watchful atmosphere.
